events.title: 2026 Best of the West and NRHA Southwest Affiliate Championship
events.description: This regional reining horse championship draws competitors of all skill levels to WestWorld of Scottsdale for a week of NRHA approved classes with more than $200,000 in added money. The event includes dedicated novice classes along with family friendly extras like morning refreshments and raffles.

events.title: Desert Design Week Fall 2026
events.venueName: Multiple Venues Across Phoenix and Scottsdale
events.description: This biannual citywide celebration pairs locals with designers, architects and artists through curated studio visits, home tours and culinary events across Phoenix and Scottsdale. The fall edition's theme, Collected In Dialog, explores design as interconnected stories.

events.title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC Tour 2026
events.description: Singer-songwriter Jack Johnson brings his SURFILMUSIC Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, with Hermanos Gutierrez opening the show.

events.title: Brit Floyd: The Moon, The Wall and Beyond
events.venueName: Linda Ronstadt Music Hall, Tucson Convention Center
events.description: Pink Floyd tribute act Brit Floyd marks its 15th anniversary with a staging of Dark Side of the Moon and The Wall, featuring a full laser and light show with LED walls and inflatables.

events.title: TLC & Salt-N-Pepa with En Vogue: It's Iconic Tour
events.description: TLC and Salt-N-Pepa co-headline their first ever joint tour, It's Iconic, with special guest En Vogue. The stop at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre marks the first time all three groups have shared a stage together.

events.title: Scottsdale Fashion Week
events.description: Scottsdale's marquee fashion event marks its 10th year with four days of runway shows, live entertainment and curated shopping experiences at venues across the city, including Scottsdale Quarter and Hotel Adeline.

events.title: $uicideboy$ Present: Grey Day Tour 2026
events.description: Hip-hop duo $uicideboy$ headline the Grey Day Tour with support from Shoreline Mafia and other acts. A second show follows the next night at the same venue.

events.title: Four Peaks Oktoberfest
events.venueAddress: 80 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: Arizona's biggest Oktoberfest takes over Tempe Beach Park with Four Peaks beer, German food, live polka and rock bands, carnival rides and stein-holding contests along Tempe Town Lake.

events.title: Ingrid Michaelson: Cozy Fall Trio Tour
events.description: Singer-songwriter Ingrid Michaelson brings her Cozy Fall Trio Tour to the historic Rialto Theatre in downtown Tucson, with support from Allie Moss and Hannah Winkler. The intimate, stripped-down show highlights Michaelson's catalog of indie-pop favorites.

events.title: Becky G: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Latin Grammy winning singer Becky G performs a full headlining set at the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series. The ticket includes reserved coliseum seating and admission to the fair, with no opening act.

events.title: FORM Arcosanti Festival
events.description: FORM returns to the experimental desert town of Arcosanti for a three day, intimate music festival capped at about 2,500 attendees. The 2026 lineup includes Disclosure, Lorde, Turnstile, Blood Orange and Kamasi Washington performing across multiple stages with no VIP or backstage separation from fans.

events.title: Sedona Arts Festival
events.time: Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.venueAddress: 995 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: This juried fine art festival brings more than 100 artists to Sedona each October, with painting, sculpture, jewelry, ceramics and photography set against red rock views.

events.title: Phoenix Suns Preseason vs. San Antonio Spurs
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the reigning Western Conference champion San Antonio Spurs in a preseason matchup at Mortgage Matchup Center. It is one of two home preseason games on the Suns' 2026 exhibition schedule.

events.title: All Time Low: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Pop punk band All Time Low headlines the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series, playing favorites from their two decade catalog. Doors open at 6:00 PM, and the ticket price includes fair admission.

events.title: Thomas Rhett: The Soundtrack to Life Tour
events.description: Country hitmaker Thomas Rhett brings The Soundtrack to Life Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, with support from ERNEST and Emily Ann Roberts. The show spans Rhett catalog of number one Billboard Hot Country hits.

events.title: Tucson Symphony Orchestra: Jose Luis Gomez, Concierto de Aranjuez
events.time: Sat 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM
events.description: Conductor Jose Luis Gomez leads the Tucson Symphony Orchestra in this Masterworks program featuring guitarist Rafael Aguirre performing Joaquin Rodrigo's Concierto de Aranjuez. The program also includes Marianna Martines' Sinfonia in C Major and Haydn's Surprise Symphony.

events.title: Wings & Wheels 2026: Sedona Airport Day
events.description: The Sedona Oak Creek Airport Authority hosts its annual community open house with vintage aircraft, warbirds and static aircraft displays on the mesa overlooking the red rocks. The event also includes the Sedona Car Club show and food trucks, with free parking and admission.

events.title: Phoenix Lowrider Magazine Super Show
events.description: Lowrider Magazine brings its Super Show to the Phoenix Convention Center with custom car clubs, master builders and hydraulic hopping competitions. The family friendly event also includes live music and vendor booths celebrating lowrider heritage.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Detroit Lions
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the Detroit Lions in a Week 5 NFL matchup at State Farm Stadium. Kickoff is set for 1:25 PM.

events.title: Red Rocks Oktoberfest
events.description: Sedona's annual Bavarian-style craft beer festival features brewery tastings, food trucks, live music and a stein-holding contest at Posse Grounds Park. The event benefits youth-oriented programs supported by the Rotary Club of Sedona Red Rocks, with a free shuttle available from around town.

events.title: Staind: Break The Cycle 25th Anniversary Tour
events.description: Staind marks 25 years of their album Break the Cycle with a headlining amphitheatre show, joined by Seether, Hoobastank and Hinder. The outdoor concert is a stop on the band's 2026 anniversary tour.

events.title: Logic & G-Eazy: The Endless Summer Tour Part II
events.description: Rappers Logic and G-Eazy co-headline the Endless Summer Tour Part II at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, with Juicy J as special guest. The stop is part of a 23 city North American amphitheater run.

events.title: Highly Suspect & Yelawolf: The War Within Tour
events.venueName: Pepsi Amphitheater at Fort Tuthill Park
events.description: Rock duo Highly Suspect co-headlines with rapper Yelawolf on the outdoor stage at Fort Tuthill Park, joined by special guest Passengers Unknown. Doors open at 5:00 PM for the 7:00 PM show.

events.title: Phoenix Raceway Fan Fest
events.description: Phoenix Raceway kicks off its NASCAR Championship race weekend with a free, family friendly Fan Fest in downtown Phoenix. The event features driver meet and greets, show cars, live music, food vendors and kids activities.

events.title: The Offspring: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Alt-rock veterans The Offspring headline the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series with a full set of their hits. The reserved seating show includes fair admission, no opening act.

events.title: Sedona Plein Air Festival
events.description: The 22nd annual Sedona Plein Air Festival brings painters from across the country to capture the red rock landscape on location around Sedona and the Verde Valley. Public events from October 19 through 24 include paint-outs, artist demonstrations and an awards ceremony, followed by a gallery exhibition at the Sedona Arts Center.

events.title: Phoenix Suns Preseason vs. Utah Jazz
events.description: The Suns close out their five game preseason slate at home against the Utah Jazz at Mortgage Matchup Center. It is the second of two home exhibition games on the 2026 schedule.

events.title: Yuma County Fall Fest
events.description: The 5th annual Fall Fest brings carnival rides, a seasonal maze, pumpkin carving and strolling performers to the Yuma County Fairgrounds over three days. The weekend closes Sunday evening with a demolition derby.

events.title: Tucson Meet Yourself
events.description: This free three-day folklife festival celebrates Tucson's ethnic and cultural diversity with traditional food, music, and craft demonstrations across several downtown blocks. The 2026 edition ties into a Smithsonian-affiliated village highlighting the city's makers and storytellers.

events.title: Helldorado Days
events.description: Tombstone's 97th annual Helldorado Days brings parades, gunfight re-enactments and Old West pageantry to the town's historic streets. The three day celebration is Tombstone's longest running festival.

events.title: Original Phoenix Greek Festival
events.time: Fri 3-10 PM, Sat 11 AM-10 PM, Sun 11 AM-6 PM
events.description: The 65th annual Phoenix Greek Festival brings three days of Greek food, folk dancing and cathedral tours to Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Cathedral. Visitors can sample gyros, souvlaki and baklava, browse Mediterranean goods and take a self-guided tour of the cathedral's stained glass.

events.title: Tucson Roadrunners vs. San Diego Gulls (Game 1)
events.description: The Tucson Roadrunners open a two game home series against the San Diego Gulls at Tucson Arena. The AHL affiliate of the Arizona Coyotes returns to home games in Tucson for the first time since the 2018-19 season.

events.title: Phoenix Pride Festival and Parade
events.time: Sat 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM, Sun 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM
events.venueAddress: 300 E Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85012
events.description: One of the Southwest's largest LGBTQ+ celebrations features performers across multiple stages, hundreds of vendors and exhibitors, and the Pride Parade down 3rd Street on Sunday morning.

events.title: Fest of Fall
events.description: The City of Sedona's third annual Fest of Fall fills Posse Grounds Park with food trucks, local vendors, a pickleball tournament, cornhole tournament and a kids' zone. Live music runs into the evening alongside beer and food for purchase.

events.title: Russell Dickerson: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Country singer Russell Dickerson brings a full headlining set to the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series. The reserved seating show includes fair admission, with no opening act.

events.title: Taco Fest at Salt River Fields
events.venueName: Salt River Fields at Talking Stick
events.description: This two day culinary festival brings more than 40 taco makers and over 30 tequila and mezcal brands to Salt River Fields, alongside multiple music stages, dancing and mercado shopping. General admission covers festival access only, with food and drink purchased separately.

events.title: Scottsdale Fall Festival
events.description: This free, family friendly festival returns to the Scottsdale Civic Center with an expanded footprint and an extra hour of activities. Attendees can enjoy live music, a magic show, a pumpkin patch, Trick or Treat Alley and more than 25 carnival style games.

events.title: Sedona Lantern Festival
events.venueAddress: 3500 E Bill Gray Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: A heart centered evening where attendees float their own lantern carrying a personal prayer or wish, held around Sedona Mago Healing Lake. The event features live music, traditional Korean dance and cultural performances, with an option to extend the stay overnight for sunrise meditation.

events.title: Red Rocks of Sedona Trail Races
events.time: Morning start, times vary by distance
events.venueAddress: 3511 Verde Valley School Rd, Sedona, AZ 86351
events.description: Runners choose from a Mountain Marathon, 20 Miler, 10 Miler or 2.5 Miler, with every distance featuring the iconic Hi-Line Trail. The race is organized by Trail Running Escapes under permit from Coconino National Forest, with aid stations and a finish line at Verde Valley School.

events.title: Monsta X: The X Nexus World Tour
events.description: K-pop group Monsta X brings The X: Nexus World Tour to downtown Phoenix, showcasing the group polished choreography and genre blending pop and hip hop repertoire. The show is part of a broader 2026 world tour stop at Arizona Financial Theatre.

events.title: Copper Country Music Fest
events.venueAddress: 400 W Rodeo Rd, Casa Grande, AZ 85122
events.description: This second annual country music festival at the Casa Grande Rodeo Grounds features rising country artists including the Randy Rogers Band, along with a vendor market and food court. The nonprofit Pinal 40 organizes the event.

events.title: Fastball Comedy Festival
events.venueAddress: 2330 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Mesa, AZ 85201
events.description: The inaugural Fastball Comedy Festival brings a two night outdoor stand up lineup to the Chicago Cubs spring training ballpark. Bill Burr and Tom Segura headline the first night on October 17, followed by Dave Chappelle and additional acts on October 18.

events.title: Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market (Fall Season Opening)
events.description: The Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market kicks off its main fall through spring season with local produce, baked goods and specialty food vendors. The market runs every Saturday morning at the Arizona Center through mid May.

events.title: Tucson Roadrunners vs. San Diego Gulls (Game 2)
events.description: The Tucson Roadrunners close out their season opening series against the San Diego Gulls at Tucson Arena. It is the second of two AHL games between the clubs that weekend.

events.title: NASCAR Cup Series Freeway Insurance 500
events.description: NASCAR playoff racing returns to Phoenix Raceway as the Freeway Insurance 500 opens the Cup Series Round of 8 on October 18, 2026, capping a full race weekend in Avondale.

events.title: Young Miko: Late Checkout Tour
events.description: Puerto Rican artist Young Miko brings her Late Checkout Tour, her first arena tour, to Mortgage Matchup Center. The 31 date run spans 11 countries and follows her recent Grammy nomination.

events.title: Foreigner: Celebrating 50 Years
events.venueName: The Pool at Talking Stick Resort
events.venueAddress: 9800 E Talking Stick Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85256
events.description: Classic rock band Foreigner performs its 50th anniversary tour at the outdoor pool venue of Talking Stick Resort, playing hits spanning the band's five-decade catalog. Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster and the resort box office.

events.title: Juanes
events.venueName: AVA Amphitheater at Casino Del Sol
events.description: Colombian rock star Juanes performs at AVA Amphitheater as part of his 2026 tour, bringing a career-spanning set of Latin rock hits.

events.title: Weezer: The Gathering with The Shins and Silversun Pickups
events.description: Weezer brings The Gathering arena tour to downtown Phoenix with support from The Shins and Silversun Pickups. Doors open 60 minutes before the scheduled start time.

events.title: Charli XCX: Music, Fashion, Film Tour
events.description: Pop artist Charli XCX brings her Music, Fashion, Film Tour to Desert Diamond Arena. The arena show blends live performance with fashion and film elements.

events.title: Strange Garden
events.description: Desert Botanical Garden transforms into an immersive Halloween season experience with curious activities, live entertainment and creature encounters, with the main festival weekend on October 23 and 24. A separate 21 and over Spirit Walk evening on October 22 adds fall cocktails along the trails.

events.title: Gorillaz: The Mountain Tour
events.description: Gorillaz bring The Mountain Tour to downtown Phoenix, with support from Little Simz and Deltron 3030. The virtual band's stadium and arena shows are known for elaborate animated visuals paired with live performance.

events.title: Spooktacular Hot Air Balloon Festival
events.venueName: Salt River Fields at Talking Stick
events.description: More than 20 hot air balloons double as trick or treat stations at this Halloween themed festival, with tethered balloon rides, a costume contest and a Spooktacular Marketplace of Halloween crafts and food. Friday and Saturday nights close with fireworks over Salt River Fields.
events.imageKeyword: hot air balloon halloween festival evening

events.title: Tucson Symphony Orchestra: Latin Sizzle
events.description: Conductor Jose Luis Gomez leads the Tucson Symphony Orchestra in a program of Latin American works featuring violinist Alexis Cardenas, including Ravel's Tzigane and Sibelius's Symphony No. 5. A free pre-concert talk begins one hour before each performance.

events.title: Gabriel Iglesias: The 1976 Tour
events.venueName: Tucson Arena at Tucson Convention Center
events.description: Comedian Gabriel Iglesias performs a rescheduled stand-up show as part of his 1976 Tour at Tucson Arena. The date was moved from an original May 2026 booking.

events.title: Tucson Spooktacular Craft & Vendor Market
events.time: Fri-Sat 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Sun 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM
events.description: An indoor and outdoor Halloween themed vendor market bringing together local, independent merchants selling food, drinks, jewelry, handmade crafts, home decor and art. The three day market runs at Tucson Mall over the weekend before Halloween.

events.title: Tucson Celtic Festival and Scottish Highland Games
events.time: Fri 5:00 PM - 9:30 PM, Sat 8:00 AM - 9:30 PM, Sun 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
events.description: This 40th annual festival brings three days of Celtic, Irish and Scottish music, Highland dancing and Scottish athletics to Rillito Raceway Park. The weekend also features bagpipe bands, whisky and beer tastings, clan tents and kids' activities.

events.title: Public Enemy: Arizona State Fair Coliseum Concert Series
events.description: Hip hop pioneers Public Enemy bring a full headlining set to the Arizona State Fair's Coliseum Concert Series. The reserved seating show includes fair admission, no opening act.

events.title: The Paul Thorn Band
events.description: Americana and blues-rock artist Paul Thorn performs with his full band in MIM's intimate 300-seat theater. Thorn blends blues, gospel, country and soul influences into original songs delivered with his distinctive, gravelly voice.
events.imageKeyword: blues rock band concert small theater

events.title: Pumpkin Walk at The Arboretum at Flagstaff
events.venueAddress: 4001 S Woody Mountain Rd, Flagstaff, AZ 86005
events.description: The Arboretum's final event of the season lights its trails with hundreds of jack-o-lanterns alongside beer, food trucks, hayrides and apple bobbing. The rain or shine event closes out the Arboretum's fall programming for the year.
events.imageKeyword: jack o lantern trail night forest

events.title: Phoenix Suns Home Opener vs. Golden State Warriors
events.description: The Suns open their 2026-27 home schedule against the Golden State Warriors at Mortgage Matchup Center. The game follows a season opening road trip that begins October 21 in Portland.

events.title: Arizona Wildcats Football vs. Iowa State (Homecoming)
events.description: Arizona hosts Iowa State in a Big 12 matchup on Homecoming weekend at Casino Del Sol Stadium. The game follows a bye week and is one of the Wildcats marquee home dates in the second half of the season.

events.title: Celebraciones de la Gente
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM - 7:30 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.venueAddress: 3101 N Fort Valley Rd, Flagstaff, AZ 86001
events.description: The Museum of Northern Arizona hosts the 23rd annual Celebraciones de la Gente, presented with Flagstaff Nuestras Raices, honoring Dia de los Muertos with cultural dances, mariachi music and illuminated ofrendas. Saturday evening includes a Courtyard After Dark session with traditional beverages, and Sunday programming runs during regular museum hours.
events.imageKeyword: day of the dead altar festival

events.title: MIKIZTLI: Dia de los Muertos Phoenix Festival
events.description: This free, family friendly festival marks its 15th year with Day of the Dead cultural performances, art vendors, food trucks, interactive art activities and a large community ofrenda in downtown Phoenix.

events.title: Pup Festival at Tempe Marketplace
events.venueAddress: 2000 E Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: This free, dog-centric event brings dog races, an agility course, a costume contest and rescue adoptions to Tempe Marketplace's District Stage. Food vendors, a mobile bar and pet-focused vendors round out the party, with proceeds benefiting local animal rescue organizations.

events.title: Dia de los Muertos Festival at Mesa Arts Center
events.time: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM (9:00 AM relaxed hour each day)
events.description: This free two-day festival honors the Day of the Dead tradition with a community altar, artisan workshops, live performances, and food vendors along a dedicated street. A quieter 'relaxed hour' opens each morning before the main crowds arrive.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Denver Broncos
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the Denver Broncos in a Week 7 NFL matchup at State Farm Stadium. Kickoff is set for 1:05 PM.

events.title: Spooky Safari at the Phoenix Zoo
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo Halloween event offers trick-or-treating stations, an hourly costume parade, animal encounters and Halloween themed crafts across three evenings. Tickets are 18 dollars per person and children age 2 and under are admitted free.

events.title: AFI
events.description: Rock band AFI plays a sold-out show at the historic Rialto Theatre, with Choir Boy opening. Resale tickets remain available through secondary marketplaces.

events.title: Sirsy Concert
events.venueAddress: 2030 W State Route 89A, Suite A-3, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: Award winning duo Sirsy, known for pairing looping guitar with powerhouse drumming and vocals, performs an intimate concert at the Mary D. Fisher Theatre. Tickets include a post-show meet and greet with the band in the lobby.

events.title: Doja Cat: Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.description: Doja Cat brings her Tour Ma Vie World Tour to downtown Phoenix's Mortgage Matchup Center, with special guest Latto. The arena show supports her fifth studio album, Vie.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Denver Nuggets (NBA Cup)
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Denver Nuggets in an NBA Cup group play game at Mortgage Matchup Center. The Friday night Western Conference matchup is one of the Suns' group stage games in the in season tournament.

events.title: Uptown Sedona Trick-or-Treat
events.description: Merchants along Uptown Sedona hand out candy to trick-or-treaters of all ages against the backdrop of the red rocks. The free event includes a community dance performance, and free parking is available in the Uptown business district.

events.title: Tucson Symphony Orchestra: Dia de los Muertos Concert
events.venueName: Linda Ronstadt Music Hall, Tucson Convention Center
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra celebrates Dia de los Muertos with a program honoring Mexican musical traditions at the Linda Ronstadt Music Hall. The afternoon concert is part of the symphony's ongoing community and culture series.

events.title: Tucson Modernism Week
events.description: Now in its 15th year, this citywide celebration of mid century design draws design enthusiasts and preservationists to lectures, insider tours and the annual Mid-Century Modern Home Tour. Events are hosted in landmark spaces around the city that showcase Tucson's desert modernism architecture.

events.title: Derek Hough: Dance For The Holidays
events.description: Emmy winning choreographer Derek Hough kicks off his Dance For The Holidays tour at the historic Orpheum Theatre in downtown Phoenix. The family friendly production features a cast of professional dancers performing festive, holiday themed routines.

events.title: Quilt, Craft & Sewing Festival
events.description: This multi-day trade show brings sewing machine dealers, quilting tool vendors, fabric sellers and craft suppliers to the Tucson Expo Center. Admission and parking are free, running Thursday and Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM.

events.title: Dan + Shay: The Young Tour
events.description: Country duo Dan + Shay bring The Young Tour to Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, playing songs from their forthcoming album Young alongside their Grammy winning hits. Tyler Hubbard and Josh Ross open the show.

events.title: Jason Derulo Live at Wild Horse Pass
events.venueName: Wild Horse Pass, Gila River Resorts & Casinos
events.venueAddress: 5040 Wild Horse Pass Blvd, Chandler, AZ 85226
events.description: Pop and R&B hitmaker Jason Derulo performs a headlining show at Wild Horse Pass, part of the Gila River Resorts & Casinos concert series. The set spans his catalog of chart topping singles.

events.title: Roars & Pours
events.description: This adults only evening at the Phoenix Zoo pairs a sneak peek of the ZooLights display with pours from Arizona breweries and distilleries. The 21 and over event also includes camel rides, Safari Cruiser tours and a wildlife presentation at the Doornbos Discovery Amphitheater.

events.title: Canal Convergence: Water + Art + Light
events.description: Scottsdale's free public art festival marks its 15th anniversary with ten nights of large-scale, light-based art installations along the Arizona Canal, plus live music, workshops and artist talks.

events.title: Canal Convergence: Most Western
events.description: Scottsdale Arts free 10 night public art event transforms the banks of the Arizona Canal with large scale, interactive light and water installations. The 2026 edition marks the festival 15th anniversary and Scottsdale 75th anniversary with the theme Most Western.

events.title: Arizona Wildcats Football vs. TCU
events.description: The Arizona Wildcats host TCU in a Big 12 matchup at Casino Del Sol Stadium after the conference moved the game to Friday, November 6. The rescheduling places the Horned Frogs matchup on a rare weeknight slot for Arizona.

events.title: Sedona Mountain Bike Festival
events.description: This three day festival brings bike demos, guided rides, skills clinics and industry vendors to Sedona famed red rock singletrack trails. Live entertainment and food trucks run at Posse Grounds Park throughout the weekend, with free shuttles to local trailheads for pass holders.

events.title: Cristian Castro: Nada Solo Exitos Tour
events.description: Mexican singer Cristian Castro performs greatest hits from his decades long career as part of the Nada Solo Exitos Tour at Desert Diamond Arena.

events.title: Southern Arizona Blues Heritage Festival
events.description: The Southern Arizona Blues Heritage Foundation biggest event of the year fills the bandshell area of Kennedy Park with a full day of live blues performances. The family friendly festival also includes food and craft vendors.

events.title: Arizona Fall Festival
events.description: Local First Arizona marks the 20th anniversary of its Certified Local Fall Festival at Hance Park, gathering more than 200 Arizona makers, local businesses and artisans. The free, family friendly day includes local food and drink, live music and shopping in the heart of downtown Phoenix.

events.title: Space Cadet Fest
events.description: Space Cadet Fest brings a three stage, space themed music festival to Walter Studios in Phoenix, curated by local band Playboy Manbaby. The lineup includes electronic composer Dan Deacon and indie prog rock act The Toxhards, with sci-fi costumes encouraged.

events.title: Bentley Scottsdale Polo Championships
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM
events.description: Billed as America's most attended polo event, the weekend features the Molina Cup polo matches, an Arabian horse showcase, live music, fashion presentations and wine tastings. The 2026 edition adds an international England versus France polo matchup.

events.title: Scottsdale Italian Festival
events.time: 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM Saturday, 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM Sunday
events.description: The Italian Association of Arizona's 11th annual festival fills the Scottsdale Civic Center with Italian food vendors, wine tasting, live music and cultural performances. The two day event is free to attend and family friendly.

events.title: Tucson Symphony Orchestra: Brahms' Fourth
events.time: Sat 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra's Masterworks Series continues with a program built around Brahms' Fourth Symphony. The concert is sponsored by the Connie Hillman Family Foundation as part of the orchestra's season at Catalina Foothills High School.

events.title: Foodie Fest West: Fall Edition
events.description: PS I Love AZ brings its open air food truck and vendor festival to the Peoria Sports Complex for a fall edition. The event features a pie eating contest, axe throwing, a petting zoo and a kids zone alongside local food trucks and shopping vendors.

events.title: Kierland Fine Art & Wine Festival
events.description: More than 100 juried artists display fine art along Kierland Commons Main Street, paired with tastings from Arizona regional wineries and live music. Admission is free, with wine tasting available for a separate ticket.

events.title: All Souls Procession
events.description: More than 150,000 participants join this two-mile, human-powered procession honoring departed loved ones, inspired by Dia de los Muertos and culminating in the ceremonial burning of the Urn.

events.title: Don Omar: The Last King World Tour
events.description: Reggaeton artist Don Omar brings The Last King World Tour to downtown Phoenix, performing hits from across his catalog at Mortgage Matchup Center.

events.title: The Smashing Pumpkins: The Rats In A Cage Tour
events.description: The Smashing Pumpkins bring The Rats In A Cage Tour to downtown Phoenix, marking the 30th anniversary of Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness with a full performance of the album alongside a set spanning the band nearly four decade catalog.

events.title: Sabaton: Legends on Tour
events.description: Swedish power metal band Sabaton performs at Arizona Financial Theatre on their Legends on Tour, rescheduled from an earlier February date, with support from Pop Evil and Wings of Steel.

events.title: Charles Schwab Cup Championship
events.time: Tournament rounds, times vary by day
events.description: The season-ending event of the PGA Tour Champions crowns the winner of the Charles Schwab Cup at Phoenix Country Club. The four-day tournament features the top point earners from the over-50 professional golf tour competing on one of Phoenix's historic private courses.

events.title: Fall Fountain Festival of Fine Arts & Crafts
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.venueAddress: Avenue of the Fountains, Fountain Hills, AZ 85268
events.description: Held the second full weekend of November for over 50 years, this free juried festival brings hundreds of artists and artisans to downtown Fountain Hills beside one of the world's tallest fountains.

events.title: The Hondo Rodeo Fest
events.time: Street Fest opens 12:00 PM daily, rodeo and concerts in the evening
events.description: The Hondo Rodeo Fest returns to Chase Field for its third consecutive year, combining a million dollar rodeo competition with nightly concerts from Tim McGraw, Blake Shelton and Parker McCollum. The free Hondo Street Fest runs daily alongside the ticketed rodeo and concert program.

events.title: DUSK Music Festival
events.time: Doors 2:30 PM, show 3:00 PM, curfew 11:00 PM
events.description: Relentless Beats and Rio Nuevo present the 10th anniversary edition of DUSK Music Festival in downtown Tucson, an all ages electronic music event with 43 performers across headliners, supporting acts and local artists at Jacome Plaza.

events.title: Sidepony Express Music Festival
events.description: The 13th annual Sidepony Express Music Festival fills bars, theaters and streets across historic Bisbee with more than 100 underground and independent bands over three days. Admission to the festival is free to the public.

events.title: Tucson Fall Craft & Vendor Market
events.time: Friday-Saturday 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Sunday 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM
events.description: Hometown Vendor Market brings dozens of craft and small business vendors indoors to Tucson Mall for a three day fall shopping event. Handmade goods, holiday gifts and local art are featured throughout the mall's common areas.

events.title: Copper State Whiskey Festival
events.venueAddress: 2330 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Mesa, AZ 85201
events.description: Arizona's largest whiskey festival takes over Sloan Park, the Chicago Cubs' spring training stadium, for an evening of tastings. The event includes luxury suite access and a dedicated cigar lounge alongside whiskey vendors from around the country.

events.title: Phoenix Pizza Festival
events.time: Sat 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 11th annual Phoenix Pizza Festival brings local pizza makers together at Hance Park to sell slices, full pies and other pizza inspired creations. The two day event also features live music from local bands, a vendor market and kids activities, with proceeds benefiting Downtown Phoenix, Inc.

events.title: Country Christmas at the Farm
events.description: Mortimer Farms transforms into a holiday walk with lighted displays, a nativity scene, pony rides and photos with Santa on select dates. The farm market and deli stay open daily through the run, which closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

events.title: Teddy Swims: The UGLY Tour
events.description: Grammy nominated singer Teddy Swims headlines The UGLY Tour at Mortgage Matchup Center, with special guests Natasha Bedingfield and MarcLo. The arena show is part of the singer fall 2026 tour.

events.title: Christmas at the Princess
events.description: The Fairmont Scottsdale Princess transforms into a desert winter wonderland with millions of lights, a Christmas tree lagoon show, ice skating and train rides. The event runs nightly from the week before Thanksgiving through early January each year.

events.title: Better Together 2026
events.venueAddress: 300 E Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85012
events.description: This 18 and up, two day electronic music festival returns to Steele Indian School Park after the 2025 edition was canceled for weather and safety reasons. Relentless Beats, Arizona's flagship EDM promoter, presents the celebration of music, unity and community.

events.title: El Tour de Tucson
events.description: The 43rd El Tour de Tucson, one of America's largest charity cycling events, draws thousands of riders to loop courses around Tucson on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with distances for all abilities.

events.title: Dial Up Festival
events.description: This new traveling festival celebrates late 1990s and early 2000s music and culture, with Nelly and Sugar Ray headlining a lineup that also includes Smash Mouth, Alien Ant Farm, Warren G, Paul Wall and Unwritten Law. The single day event runs from early afternoon into the evening with themed bars, vendors and photo ops.

events.title: Howdy Tucson! Music of the American West
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra opens its Live at the Ronstadt pops series with a program of Western classics, including The Arizona Waltz and music from How the West Was Won and The Magnificent Seven. Conductor Evan Roider leads the orchestra with baritone Nathaniel Hackmann.

events.title: Arizona Indigenous Culinary Experience
events.venueAddress: 12621 N Frank Lloyd Wright Blvd, Scottsdale, AZ 85259
events.description: Held during Native American Heritage Month at Frank Lloyd Wright's Taliesin West, this event pairs curated tasting stations and live culinary demonstrations from Indigenous chefs with a Native fashion showcase. The evening highlights foodways and design traditions from Arizona's Native communities.

events.title: Three Days Grace: Alienation Tour
events.description: Rock band Three Days Grace headlines its Alienation Tour at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, with support from I Prevail and The Funeral Portrait. The stop is part of a fall 2026 North American arena and amphitheater run.

events.title: Ye (Kanye West): Live in Phoenix
events.description: Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, plays the only Arizona date of his stadium tour supporting the album Bully. It marks his first metro Phoenix concert since 2020.

events.title: Phoenix Spartan Trifecta Weekend
events.description: Phoenix Raceway hosts a full weekend of Spartan obstacle course races, including the Sprint 5K, Super 10K and Beast 21K distances along with a kids race. Racers who complete all three main distances over the weekend earn Trifecta status.

events.title: Steep Canyon Rangers
events.description: Grammy winning bluegrass band Steep Canyon Rangers headline the historic Fox Tucson Theatre with support from Eugene Boronow. The band is known for its work with Steve Martin as well as its own string band catalog.

events.title: Kimes Ranch Million Dollar Breakaway
events.description: Billed as the richest breakaway roping in the world, this championship brings 20 qualifying finalists to WestWorld of Scottsdale for 10 evening performances competing for a $1,000,000 purse. The event caps a season of qualifying rodeos held across the country.

events.title: KATSEYE: The Wildworld Tour
events.description: Global pop group KATSEYE brings The Wildworld Tour to the Mortgage Matchup Center, featuring six vocalists and full arena scale staging and choreography.

events.title: Lake Havasu Festival of Lights
events.venueAddress: 1477 Queens Bay, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: More than 500,000 lights illuminate the historic London Bridge and surrounding English Village for this free holiday season display. Visitors can walk the lakefront path or view the lights by boat along the Bridgewater Channel.

events.title: ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo's beloved holiday tradition features millions of twinkling lights, glowing animal lanterns and lakeside light shows. ZooLights runs nightly from late November through mid-January each season.

events.title: Sedona Turkey Trot 5K
events.description: The 17th annual Sedona Turkey Trot offers a Thanksgiving morning 5K and kids fun run starting and finishing at Posse Grounds Park. Cash prizes go to overall winners, with gift card awards for masters and age group finishers.

events.title: Glendale Glitters
events.description: Nearly one million holiday lights illuminate 12 blocks of Historic Downtown Glendale's Old Towne and Catlin Court districts, with free weekend performances at Murphy Park. Lights glow nightly from the Friday after Thanksgiving through early January.

events.title: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again
events.description: The Jonas Brothers bring an expanded version of their sold out Burning Up Tour celebration to Desert Diamond Arena, with support from Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa. The stop honors the band catalog spanning two decades.

events.title: Glendale Glitters Holiday Lights
events.time: Kickoff Nov 27-28, 5-10 PM; lights nightly 5-10 PM through Jan 1
events.description: Glendale Glitters lights up Murphy Park and the surrounding historic district with a large scale holiday light display each winter. The 2026 kickoff weekend includes an official tree lighting ceremony, live entertainment, and holiday shopping among the district's antique shops, with the lights remaining on through New Year's Day.

events.title: Territorial Cup: Arizona vs. Arizona State
events.venueAddress: 1 N National Championship Dr, Tucson, AZ 85719
events.description: Arizona and Arizona State close the regular season with the Territorial Cup rivalry game at Arizona Stadium. The annual matchup is one of the oldest rivalry trophies in college football.

events.title: Bluey's Big Play
events.description: The hit stage adaptation of the Emmy winning animated series brings Bluey, Bingo, Bandit and Chilli to life for an interactive family show. The touring production stops in Phoenix for two days with multiple performances.

events.title: Scottsdazzle
events.description: Scottsdazzle is Scottsdale official holiday celebration, filling Old Town with seasonal lights, decorations and a lineup of free community events through New Year. The season includes the Scottsdale Waterfront tree lighting, Merry Main Street window art and holiday shopping and dining throughout the district.

events.title: Banda MS: Somos MS Tour
events.description: Regional Mexican band Banda MS performs as part of the Somos MS Tour at Mortgage Matchup Center in downtown Phoenix.

events.title: The Fab Four: Tribute to the Beatles
events.description: The Fab Four recreate the look and sound of the Beatles across their career, from the Hard Day's Night era through the band's later hits. The tribute show is a regular stop on the group's national touring schedule.

events.title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock LIVE
events.venueName: Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Jim Henson's Creature Shop brings a live stage adaptation of Fraggle Rock to Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts, featuring walk around Fraggle puppets, Doozers and a giant Gorg. The family friendly show appeals to both longtime fans and viewers of the newer Apple TV Plus series.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Washington Commanders
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the Washington Commanders in a Week 12 NFL matchup at State Farm Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:25 PM, with the game broadcast on FOX.

events.title: Ashley McBryde
events.description: Grammy nominated country singer-songwriter Ashley McBryde performs at the historic Fox Tucson Theatre. Known for her raw, narrative songwriting, McBryde has built her career on albums like Girl Going Nowhere and Never Will.

events.title: The Neighbourhood: Wourld Tour
events.description: Alternative rock band The Neighbourhood brings its Wourld Tour to Mortgage Matchup Center in support of the album Ultrasound, the group first release since a 2022 to 2025 hiatus. Nessa Barrett opens the show.

events.title: Rush: Fifty Something
events.description: Rush performs at Desert Diamond Arena as part of the Fifty Something tour marking five decades since the band formed. A second Glendale date follows on December 3, 2026.

events.title: Tempe Fall Festival of the Arts
events.description: This three-day street fair fills Mill Avenue with more than 300 juried artist booths spanning ceramics, jewelry, photography, and woodwork. The festival, a past Pinnacle Award winner from the International Festival and Events Association, also features live music, a kids' activity block, and a chalk art competition.

events.title: Holiday Artist Market
events.time: Fri 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM (opening reception), Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM
events.description: The Sedona Arts Center hosts about 25 artists and makers from Sedona and around Arizona for this annual holiday market. The juried show features ceramics, jewelry, paintings and textiles, opening with a Friday evening reception.

events.title: APS Electric Light Parade
events.venueAddress: Central Ave & Montebello Ave to 7th St & Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ
events.description: The annual APS Electric Light Parade sends illuminated floats down Central Avenue in Phoenix, starting at Montebello Avenue and ending near Indian School Road. Street closures run along Central Avenue, 7th Street and Camelback Road from 5 to 11 PM for the evening procession.

events.title: Downtown Parade of Lights
events.description: Downtown Tucson lights up for its annual holiday parade, with a festival and entertainment at Jacome Plaza before illuminated floats move through the El Presidio neighborhood. The event is presented by Rio Nuevo as part of the city winter holiday celebrations.

events.title: Prescott Christmas Parade & Courthouse Lighting
events.time: Parade 1:00 PM, Courthouse Lighting 5:00 PM with fireworks
events.description: Prescott's 44th annual Christmas Parade winds through downtown before the 72nd annual Courthouse Lighting ceremony illuminates the Yavapai County Courthouse Plaza that evening, capped with a fireworks display. Both events are free and mark the traditional kickoff to Prescott's Christmas City season.

events.title: Casa Grande Electric Light Parade
events.time: Glow Before the Show 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM, parade kickoff 5:45 PM
events.description: Casa Grande's Electric Light Parade sends illuminated floats down Florence Boulevard as part of a citywide holiday celebration that starts earlier that afternoon with family activities at Peart Park. The parade is free to attend and is livestreamed for those who cannot attend in person.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Philadelphia Eagles
events.description: The Cardinals welcome the Philadelphia Eagles to State Farm Stadium for a Week 13 NFL regular season matchup. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:05 PM, with the game broadcast on FOX.

events.title: Fourth Avenue Winter Street Fair
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 57th annual Fourth Avenue Winter Street Fair brings more than 350 artists from around the world to Tucson historic Fourth Avenue district, alongside live entertainment and food vendors. The free three day fair is one of the top rated community celebrations in the Southwest.

events.title: Alt-AZ 93.3 Presents: Ugly Sweater Holiday Party with Sublime, Slightly Stoopid and Codefendants
events.description: Alt-AZ 93.3 hosts a holiday themed concert headlined by Sublime, with support from Slightly Stoopid and Codefendants. The show blends ska and reggae rock with a festive ugly sweater theme.

events.title: Acker Night Musical Showcase
events.time: Opening ceremony 5:00 PM, showcase 5:30 PM - 8:30 PM
events.description: Acker Night is a free walking musical showcase held throughout historic downtown Prescott, with local and touring musicians performing inside shops, galleries, and restaurants along the route. Now in its 38th year, the event benefits the Acker Musical Scholarship Foundation.

events.title: Alice Cooper's Christmas Pudding
events.description: Alice Cooper hosts his annual Christmas Pudding benefit concert at Celebrity Theatre, joined this year by Dee Snider, Lzzy Hale and Joe Hottinger of Halestorm, John 5 and the Creatures, and Sixwire. Proceeds support music, art and dance programs at Solid Rock Teen Centers.

events.title: Christmas in the Park
events.venueAddress: 279 N La Loma Ave, Litchfield Park, AZ 85340
events.description: Litchfield Park's annual Christmas in the Park festival features a hometown holiday parade followed by a full day of vendor booths, live stage performances, and children's activities in Litchfield Square Park. More than 60 vendors sell gifts, art, and holiday treats at this free, family oriented event.

events.title: Lake Havasu Parade of Lights
events.venueAddress: 422 English Village, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: Decorated boats parade through the Bridgewater Channel beneath the London Bridge for Lake Havasu City's annual Parade of Lights, part of the city's broader Festival of Lights celebration. The free event follows the Dock Glow at London Bridge Resort the night before and draws large crowds along the waterfront walkway.

events.title: Handel's Messiah
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra and TSO Chorus perform Handel Messiah under conductor Patrick Dupre Quigley, with featured vocal soloists. The holiday tradition runs for two afternoon performances.

events.title: Pentatonix: Christmas in the City Tour
events.description: A cappella group Pentatonix brings its Christmas in the City Tour to Desert Diamond Arena, performing holiday classics and original arrangements. The Grammy winning group tours arenas nationwide each December.

events.title: Matt Rife: Stay Golden World Tour, Live in the Round
events.description: Comedian Matt Rife performs stand-up in the round over two nights at Mortgage Matchup Center as part of his Stay Golden World Tour. The in the round staging places the comedian at the center of the arena floor.

events.title: Vrbo Fiesta Bowl - College Football Playoff Quarterfinal
events.description: The Vrbo Fiesta Bowl hosts a College Football Playoff quarterfinal at State Farm Stadium on December 30, 2026, the only CFP game played that day, giving Arizona an exclusive national spotlight.

events.title: Decadence Arizona: Sands of Eternity
events.description: The Southwest largest New Year electronic dance music festival returns to Phoenix Raceway for two nights, presented by Relentless Beats. The 2026 Sands of Eternity edition features headliners including Chris Lake, Slander and KETTAMA across multiple stages, and is 18 and up.
events.imageKeyword: electronic dance music festival night stage

events.title: New Year's Eve Whiskey Row Boot Drop
events.time: 7:00 PM - Midnight, boot drops at 10:00 PM and Midnight
events.description: A six foot illuminated cowboy boot drops twice, at 10 PM and midnight, from the Palace building flagpole to ring in the new year on historic Whiskey Row. The free 16th annual celebration includes live music, food trucks, carnival games and fireworks at both drops.
events.imageKeyword: new years eve street celebration fireworks

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. New York Knicks
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the New York Knicks in a New Year's Eve matchup at Mortgage Matchup Center. The game is one of the nationally featured contests on the Suns' 2026-27 regular season schedule.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Las Vegas Raiders
events.description: The Cardinals host the Las Vegas Raiders in a Week 17 matchup at State Farm Stadium, broadcast on CBS. It is one of the final home games of Arizona's 2026 regular season.

events.title: Arizona Balloon Classic
events.time: Fri 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM, Sat-Sun 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM
events.description: The Arizona Balloon Classic brings morning hot air balloon ascensions and evening balloon glows to Wild Horse Pass Festival Grounds. The weekend also includes the Street FoodFest with food vendors and live entertainment.

events.title: Tucson Jazz Festival
events.description: The Tucson Jazz Festival brings two weeks of performances to downtown venues including the Fox Tucson Theatre, Rialto Theatre and the Century Room. The lineup spans swing, Latin and fusion jazz alongside a free outdoor Downtown Jazz Fiesta.

events.title: Rock 'n' Roll Running Series Arizona
events.description: Thousands of runners take on the marathon, half marathon, 10K and 5K with live bands lining courses through Phoenix and Tempe. The marathon runs Sunday, January 17, 2027, finishing near ASU in Tempe.

events.title: Quartzsite Sports, Vacation & RV Show
events.description: Known simply as The Big Tent, this nine-day show is the centerpiece of Quartzsite's massive winter RV gathering, with hundreds of vendors serving the hundreds of thousands of RVers who descend on the desert town each January.

events.title: Celebration of Fine Art
events.venueAddress: Southwest corner of Hayden Road and Mayo Boulevard, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
events.description: Celebration of Fine Art is a working artist exhibition held daily under a series of large white tents in north Scottsdale. Visitors can watch more than 100 painters, sculptors, glass artists and photographers create original work on site and purchase directly from the artists. The show runs for over two months, from mid January through late March.

events.title: Havasu Balloon Festival and Fair
events.venueAddress: 699 London Bridge Rd, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: Dozens of hot air balloons fill the sky over Lake Havasu during this four-day festival featuring mass ascensions, evening balloon glows, a carnival, vendors and live entertainment near the London Bridge.

events.title: Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale Collector Car Auction
events.description: The World's Greatest Collector Car Auction returns to WestWorld of Scottsdale January 23-31, 2027, with more than a thousand collector cars crossing the block plus exhibits, thrill rides and automotive lifestyle displays.

events.title: Arizona Renaissance Festival
events.venueAddress: 12601 E US Highway 60, Gold Canyon, AZ 85118
events.description: A 16th-century European village springs to life east of Apache Junction with jousting knights, artisan shops, 13 stages of entertainment and giant turkey legs. Open weekends February 6 through April 4, 2027, plus Presidents' Day Monday.

events.title: WM Phoenix Open
events.description: The Greatest Show on Grass brings the PGA TOUR and the world's rowdiest golf hole, the stadium-seated 16th, to TPC Scottsdale February 8-14, 2027, with tournament rounds Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Tucson Gem & Mineral Show
events.description: The flagship show of the world-famous Tucson Gem, Mineral & Fossil Showcase runs February 11-14, 2027 at the Tucson Convention Center, capping weeks of citywide gem shows that begin in late January.

events.title: Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show
events.description: Nearly 2,400 of the world's finest Arabian horses compete over 11 days at WestWorld in this signature Scottsdale event, which also features shopping expos, demonstrations and family activities.

events.title: Wickenburg Gold Rush Days & Senior Pro Rodeo
events.description: Wickenburg's 77th annual Gold Rush Days celebrates the town's mining heritage with a senior pro rodeo, parade, carnival, gold panning and artisan fair over Presidents' Day weekend.

events.title: Cactus League Opening Day: Diamondbacks vs. Rockies
events.venueName: Salt River Fields at Talking Stick
events.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks open the 2027 Cactus League spring training season with a split squad game against the Colorado Rockies at their shared spring training home, Salt River Fields at Talking Stick. It is one of eight games across the Cactus League on opening day.

events.title: Cactus League Spring Training
events.description: Fifteen MLB teams, including the Diamondbacks, Cubs and Dodgers, play spring training baseball at ten ballparks around the Valley. Games traditionally begin the third weekend of February and run through late March; the official 2027 schedule is released in fall 2026.

events.title: Tucson Rodeo - La Fiesta de los Vaqueros
events.description: One of the top 25 professional rodeos in North America, La Fiesta de los Vaqueros runs February 20-28, 2027 and includes the Tucson Rodeo Parade, billed as the world's longest non-motorized parade, on February 25.

events.title: Sedona International Film Festival
events.description: The 33rd annual Sedona International Film Festival screens features, documentaries, shorts and animated films over nine days at venues around Sedona, including the Mary D. Fisher Theatre and the Alice Gill-Sheldon Theatre. Many filmmakers attend in person for post-screening discussions.

events.title: Innings Festival
events.venueAddress: 80 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: This baseball-meets-music festival returns to Tempe Beach Park February 26-28, 2027 with three stages of rock, pop and indie acts plus MLB player appearances, timed to the start of spring training.

events.title: Lost Dutchman Days Rodeo & Carnival
events.venueAddress: 1590 E Lost Dutchman Blvd, Apache Junction, AZ 85119
events.description: Apache Junction's signature celebration beneath the Superstition Mountains features three days of pro rodeo, a 30-ride carnival and a downtown parade on Saturday morning, February 27.

events.title: Devour Culinary Classic
events.description: Devour Culinary Classic returns to the Desert Botanical Garden for a weekend of tastings from Arizona restaurants, wineries, breweries and artisan food producers. The event is presented by Local First Arizona and set among the garden's desert landscape.

events.title: Heard Museum Guild Indian Fair & Market
events.time: Sat 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 69th annual Indian Fair & Market gathers hundreds of the nation's most acclaimed American Indian artists at the Heard Museum, with juried art, music, dance performances and Native foods.

events.title: Desert Bluegrass Festival
events.venueAddress: 12205 N Tangerine Farms Rd, Marana, AZ 85653
events.description: The Desert Bluegrass Festival brings three days of live bluegrass music to Gladden Farms Community Park in Marana. The family friendly event includes workshops, a band scramble, kids' activities, craft vendors and food trucks, with tent and RV camping available on site.

events.title: Tempe Spring Festival of the Arts
events.description: The 50th Spring Tempe Festival of the Arts fills Mill Avenue in downtown Tempe with juried fine art, craft vendors, live entertainment and food booths. The three day outdoor festival draws artists and shoppers from across the Valley to one of Arizona's longest running arts events.

events.title: Tucson Festival of Books
events.description: One of the largest free book festivals in the country returns to the University of Arizona campus with author panels, a science exposition, food trucks and children's activities. The two day event draws well over 100,000 attendees each year.

events.title: TENWEST Festival
events.description: TENWEST is the largest entrepreneurship and creativity festival in the Southwest, hosted by Startup Tucson across venues throughout downtown Tucson. Founders, creators, innovators and community builders gather for talks, workshops and networking. The 2027 edition includes a new title sponsorship from Vantage West Credit Union.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks Home Opener vs. Miami Marlins
events.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks open their 2027 home schedule at Chase Field against the Miami Marlins, kicking off a six game homestand that continues with the Los Angeles Dodgers. The game follows a season opening road trip to San Diego, with first pitch time not yet announced.

events.title: Country Thunder Arizona 2027
events.venueAddress: 20585 E Price Station Rd, Florence, AZ 85132
events.description: Country Thunder Arizona returns to Canyon Moon Ranch in Florence for four days of country music, camping and Southwest desert atmosphere. Headliners and full lineup are announced ahead of the event, with reserved seating, general admission and camping packages available.

events.title: Tucson International Mariachi Conference
events.description: The 45th Tucson International Mariachi Conference brings together mariachi and folklorico performers from across the Southwest and Mexico for a week of workshops, youth showcases and concerts. The event culminates in a headline Espectacular concert featuring nationally known mariachi acts.
